traits.name: Immunities
traits.description: The Sleepless is immune to the Stunned and Surprised conditions.

traits.name: Divisible
traits.description: After the Sleepless takes impact or keen damage, they can immediately use their Divide to send out one hordeling (no action required).

actions.name: Unsettle
actions.description: Costs 1 Focus. The Sleepless eerily distorts their form toward an enemy they can sense within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Discipline test or lose 1d4 focus.

actions.name: Divide
actions.description: The Sleepless can divide the swarm that comprises them, decreasing their health by 5 per hordeling sent out. Each hordeling is a Small character with 5 health who otherwise uses the statistics of a Sleepless. These hordelings immediately gain a reaction, but they can't use actions until the next round. Anything a hordeling learns is known by the rest of their horde.

actions.name: Swarm Weapon
actions.description: After the Sleepless is hit by a melee attack, the hordelings that comprise them can momentarily swarm the attacker's weapon, giving the attacker a disadvantage on their next test against the Sleepless.

strikes.name: Overwhelm
strikes.on-hit: if the Sleepless has at least 25 health, they can smother the target. While smothering a target, the Sleepless occupies the target's space and can't attack other enemies. At the start of each of the Sleepless's turns, a smothered target takes 7 (2d6) vital damage. If the Sleepless takes more than 20 damage from a single attack or is reduced below 25 health, they release the smothered target, fall Prone within 5 feet of the target, and no longer occupy the target's space.
strikes.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 7 (2d6) keen damage. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) keen damage, and if the Sleepless has at least 25 health, they can smother the target. While smothering a target, the Sleepless occupies the target's space and can't attack other enemies. At the start of each of the Sleepless's turns, a smothered target takes 7 (2d6) vital damage. If the Sleepless takes more than 20 damage from a single attack or is reduced below 25 health, they release the smothered target, fall Prone within 5 feet of the target, and no longer occupy the target's space.

strikes.name: Ravage
strikes.on-hit: the target becomes Afflicted [1d8 keen] for 2 rounds.
strikes.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 11 (2d10) keen damage. Hit: 24 (2d10 + 13) keen damage, and the target becomes Afflicted [1d8 keen] for 2 rounds.
